items.name: Klaidem Kamunaig
items.text: Foes you strike catch fire for 3 seconds.

items.name: Slieg Braduin
items.text: While held in water you swim fast, as if with a dolphin's grace.

items.name: Skiad Toirk
items.text: Blocking a melee blow throws back 30% of its damage at the attacker.

items.name: Fàindi Tobuir
items.text: Below half health you slowly regenerate.

items.name: Moinki Òiri
items.text: Arrows, bolts and other missiles do 25% less damage to you.

items.name: Tuog Stoirmi
items.text: One blow in five arcs lightning to up to 3 foes within 4 blocks of the target.

items.name: Biudag Failes
items.text: Blows to a foe facing away deal 50% more damage.

items.name: Òrdu Kàirn
items.text: Foes you strike are slowed for 1.5 seconds.

items.name: Klag Kietaig
items.text: When a blow leaves you below 35% health you turn unseen and swift for 5 seconds (once a minute).

items.name: Krius Matuin
items.text: Melee blows do 15% less damage to you.

items.name: Klaidem Moir
items.text: Blows do 30% more damage while you stand in water or rain.

items.name: Slieg Dielunach
items.text: Blows to foes that are off the ground do 40% more damage.

items.name: Skiad Reotad
items.text: Blocking a melee blow freezes the attacker: slowness III for 3 seconds.

items.name: Fàindi Grianu
items.text: Under open sky by day you slowly regenerate.

items.name: Moinki Gielach
items.text: At night you see in the dark and move faster.

items.name: Klaidem Riondag
items.text: Blows to a foe at full health do 25% more damage.

items.name: Tuog Natrach
items.text: Foes you strike are poisoned for 5 seconds.

items.name: Slieg Iuluiri
items.text: Falling onto a foe adds 1 damage per block fallen (up to 10).

items.name: Fiedag Fitig
items.text: Hostile creatures within 20 blocks glow, so you see them through walls.

items.name: Krius Famuir
items.text: You carry four extra hearts of absorption, renewed while it is worn.

items.name: Klaidem Miondun
items.text: You heal 15% of the damage you deal.

items.name: Òrdu Gobund
items.text: Blows to armoured foes do 2 extra damage per 5 points of their armour.

items.name: Skiad Soulais
items.text: While blocking, missiles do no damage to you and melee attackers are blinded for 3 seconds.

items.name: Fàindi Dànu
items.text: A fatal blow leaves you at 3 hearts with regeneration (once every 10 minutes).

items.name: Geig Ubul
items.text: Your hunger refills slowly while it is worn.

items.name: Moinki Drieguin
items.text: You take no damage from fire or lava.
